frequency_question: How often do bilateral river treaties complete all required bureaucratic and diplomatic process steps for renewal within the available pre-expiration timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes intergovernmental water-sharing or boundary river treaties that were up for renewal and successfully renewed or allowed to lapse due to administrative timing constraints. Excludes treaties with indefinite automatic renewals.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime modernization talks
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II implementation protocols
Senegal River Basin Development Organization (OMVS) protocol updates

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named water treaty processes; population of major technical water protocol renewals is small but consistently completes procedural steps when unhindered by adversarial blockages.
known_gaps: Limited to prominent structured river basin commissions and major bilateral frameworks with public timelines.
validity_reason: Bilateral bureaucratic drafting and diplomatic protocol speeds remain stable over multi-decade horizons unless major structural government overhauls occur.
